battle.name: 第二次義埃戰爭
battle.theater: 提格雷高原與阿姆巴阿拉吉山區
battle.brief: 一九三五年十月三日，義大利以約二十萬大軍自厄立特里亞越境，另一支部隊自索馬利蘭北進，十月六日奪回阿杜瓦。卡面的加特林機槍此時已屬上一代，義軍壓制高原人海靠的是八毫米機槍與三十五式自走砲；埃軍主力耗於梅喬，海萊·塞拉西出逃，義大利五月吞併埃塞俄比亞。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 交戰雙方是義大利王國與埃塞俄比亞帝國，戰場橫跨非洲之角的厄立特里亞、提格雷高原、阿姆哈拉與奧加登。義大利方面是一整套法西斯國家機器：元首墨索里尼坐鎮羅馬，以殖民政務副國務卿為樞紐遠程指揮一切；開戰時由陸軍元帥埃米利奧·德·博諾率領駐厄立特里亞的遠征軍自北面越境，總參謀部與全線督戰在同年十一月十四日由彼得羅·巴多格里奧接掌；南面義屬索馬利蘭殖民地則由魯道爾福·格拉齊亞尼以殖民總督兼戰區指揮官身份推進。義軍作戰序列以師團與旅團為骨幹，兵種含阿爾卑斯山地旅、野戰砲兵、義大利殖民軍與本地營伍、皇家空軍與海軍航空隊，另有赴非洲志願隊與龐大的勞動運輸部隊；後勤以馬薩瓦港為起點，靠鐵路、卡車與馱畜把糧秣、燃料與砲彈送上前線。埃塞俄比亞方面是帝國中央軍與各省徵召民兵：皇帝海萊·塞拉西一世以全軍最高統帥自居，副王拉斯·印魯居中統攝，野戰軍由拉斯·德斯塔（拉斯·塞尤姆）指揮，拉斯·卡薩·海盧守騰比恩，蓋博耶胡與貝萊·澤萊克各領一軍。海萊·塞拉西即位後曾重整軍制、聘請歐洲軍官並採購外國武器，中央禁衛軍與新式營已具雛形，但全軍仍以舊式步槍、馬刀和數量龐大的民兵為主，裝備體系與義大利之間整整隔著一代技術。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Kingdom of Italy and the Ethiopian Empire, with the fighting spread across the Horn of Africa between Eritrea, the Tigrayan highlands, Amhara and the Ogaden. On the Italian side stood a complete fascist state machine: the Duce Benito Mussolini directed the war from Rome through the Undersecretary of State for the Colonies; at the opening of the campaign Marshal Emilio De Bono led the expeditionary force stationed in Eritrea across the northern border, and on 14 November 1935 the overall command passed to General Pietro Badoglio as Chief of the General Staff. In the south, General Rodolfo Graziani advanced as Governor of Italian Somaliland and commander of that theatre. The Italian order of battle was built on divisions and brigades: alpine mountain troops, field artillery, colonial units and locally recruited levies, the Regia Aeronautica and naval aviation, together with a volunteer contingent for Africa and a very large body of labour and transport troops. Logistics started at the port of Massawa and pushed forward by rail, truck and pack animal. On the Ethiopian side stood the Imperial army together with provincially raised levies: Emperor Haile Selassie I was supreme commander in person, the viceroy Ras Imru ran the rear, the field army was led by Ras Desta (Ras Seyoum), Ras Kassa Hailu held the Tembien front, and Belay Zeleke and Fitawrari Gebeyehu commanded their own sectors. After his coronation Haile Selassie had reorganised the army, employed European officers and bought weapons abroad, so the central guard and the newer battalions already had a modern shape, while the army as a whole still rested on old rifles, cavalry sabres and very large numbers of militia, a full generation of technology behind the Italians.
people: 這場戰爭的關鍵人物幾乎全在最上層。墨索里尼以元首身份坐鎮羅馬，一九三五年十月三日下令越境，並在一九三五年十一月十四日撤換進展緩慢的德·博諾，改由巴多格里奧出任陸軍總參謀長全線督戰；巴多格里奧的「南面迂迴」計畫在數月之內扭轉攻勢。殖民地指揮層上，德·博諾主持厄立特里亞戰區，格拉齊亞尼主持索馬利蘭戰區，阿奧斯塔師團由亞歷山德羅·皮爾齊奧·比羅利率領，薩伏亞師團由卡洛·熱洛索指揮，熱洛索於一九三六年初接掌索馬利蘭全境，埃托雷·巴斯蒂科則在一九三六年出任非洲義大利陸軍總司令。埃塞俄比亞一方，皇帝海萊·塞拉西一世既是君主也是全軍最高統帥，一九三五年十二月二十七日更在阿爾巴納加親率中央軍夜襲意軍營地，扭轉了意軍攻勢；副王拉斯·印魯主持後方，野戰軍主將拉斯·德斯塔、騰比恩的拉斯·卡薩·海盧、蓋博耶胡與貝萊·澤萊克各領一軍。拉斯·德斯塔與貝萊·澤萊克於一九三六年三月三十一日梅喬戰役中陣亡，拉斯·卡薩·海盧於同年四月在騰比恩被俘並押往羅馬；於是卡面上這件兵器的最後一代實踐者，竟成了被押回羅馬的老兵。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities in this war all sat at the very top. Mussolini, in his capacity as Duce, ran the operation from Rome, ordered the crossing of the border on 3 October 1935 and, on 14 November 1935, replaced the slow-moving De Bono with Badoglio as Chief of the General Staff, taking charge of the whole front; Badoglio's plan of an offensive to the south turned the campaign within a few months. In the colonial command, De Bono directed the Eritrean theatre, Graziani the Somaliland theatre, the Aosta division was led by Alessandro Pirzio Biroli and the Savoia division by Carlo Geloso, who took over the whole of Somaliland in early 1936; Ettore Bastico became commander of the Italian forces in East Africa in 1936. On the Ethiopian side, Emperor Haile Selassie I was both monarch and supreme commander, and on 27 December 1935 he personally led the central army in a night attack on the Italian camps at Arba Wech, reversing the Italian offensive. The viceroy Ras Imru ran the rear, while the field army was led by Ras Desta, with Ras Kassa Hailu in Tembien and Gebeyehu and Belay Zeleke commanding their own forces. Ras Desta and Belay Zeleke were killed at the Battle of Maychew on 31 March 1936, and Ras Kassa Hailu was captured in Tembien in April and taken to Rome. The last working generation of the weapon on this card thus ended the campaign as an old man under escort in Italy.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是一八六〇年前後的美國加特林機槍，六根管子由人力搖車帶動，後坐力分散在六次擊發之間，是第一代能壓制密集隊形的連發武器。放到一九三五年的非洲之角，它早已退到軍械庫的儲備與訓練架上：義大利陸軍在殖民戰中真正壓制人海的是八毫米Modello 1914式機槍（後定名為貝雷塔M1918）與師屬機槍連，每個步兵營都配發多挺，另有約十三噸重的三十五式菲亞特-萊維利自走砲，裝四十七毫米砲，作為突擊與火力骨幹，步兵則配義大利自製的三十八式八毫米機槍。埃塞俄比亞軍大量使用自義大利與比利時繳獲的同型機槍與步槍，並輔以本地長矛。砲兵方面，意軍攜帶七十五毫米山砲與野戰砲隨步兵縱隊推進，空軍以安薩爾多SVA與薩伏亞-馬凱蒂SM.73擔任偵察與對地攻擊，運輸除卡車外大量依靠馱馬與驢隊，鐵路則自馬薩瓦經阿斯馬拉通到凱倫與梅克累。加特林本身在這場戰爭裡的位置，是義大利殖民火器譜系上已退休的上一代，它的孫輩機槍正在阿姆巴阿拉吉的山道上向埃軍傾瀉彈雨。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the American Gatling gun of about 1860, six barrels turned by a hand crank, its recoil spread across six separate shots, the first generation of repeating fire able to pin down dense formations. Set in the Horn of Africa in 1935 it had long since retired to the depot shelves and the training racks: what really kept the Ethiopian masses down for the Italians was the 8mm Modello 1914 machine gun, later designated the Beretta M1918, issued in numbers to every infantry battalion and formed into regimental machine-gun companies, together with the roughly thirteen-tonne Fiat-Revelli M35 tank carrying a 47mm gun as the spearhead and fire support, and the Italian-made 38th Model 8mm machine gun in the infantry hands. The Ethiopian army used large quantities of the same guns and rifles captured from Italian and Belgian stocks, supplemented by local spears. On the artillery side the Italians brought 75mm mountain and field guns forward with the infantry columns; the air force used Ansaldo SVA and Savoia-Marchetti SM.73 aircraft for reconnaissance and ground attack; transport beyond trucks relied heavily on mules and donkeys, and the railway ran from Massawa through Asmara to Keren and Mekelle. The Gatling's own place in this war was that of the previous generation retired from the Italian colonial weapons inventory, while its grandchildren, the machine guns, were pouring fire down the tracks below Amba Alagi.
tactics: 義大利的戰術是一條主軸線上的縱隊推進。遠征軍沿阿斯馬拉、梅克累、阿姆巴阿拉吉這條唯一可通車的公路南下，每日推進約六七十公里，縱隊由摩托化步兵、裝甲縱列與砲兵組成，卡車和馱畜把糧秣拖在後方。轉折點是一九三六年一月底巴多格里奧的「南面迂迴」計畫：阿爾卑斯山地旅在阿姆巴阿拉吉一線夜行翻越高原台地，靠登山技術攻下意軍認定不可攀的堡壘，砲兵與自走砲隨之推進。埃軍以游擊式夜襲和正面突擊對抗，一九三五年十二月二十七日的阿爾巴納加夜戰中，中央軍趁意軍營地戒備鬆懈突襲，奪走砲位與輜重，迫使義軍暫停攻勢數週。一九三六年二月起，義軍改採口袋式戰術：先以飛機偵察與砲火驅趕埃軍收攏進狹窄谷地，再由裝甲與步兵同時封鎖兩翼，三月三十一日梅喬一戰即以此法擊潰埃軍主力。埃軍則利用高原要塞、梯田與岩壁構成的天然壘塞死守，迫使義軍逐點攻堅，戰線因此拖成一路點狀消耗。
tacticsEn: Italian tactics were a column advance along a single main axis. The expeditionary force pushed south on the one motorable road running from Asmara through Mekelle to Amba Alagi, making some sixty or seventy kilometres a day, the column formed of motorised infantry, armoured echelons and artillery, with trucks and pack animals dragging the supplies behind. The turning point was Badoglio's plan of an offensive to the south at the end of January 1936: the alpine divisions marched by night across the plateau country around Amba Alagi and took by climbing what the Italians had counted as impregnable, artillery and tanks following up. The Ethiopians countered with night attacks by irregulars and frontal assaults; in the night of Arba Wech on 27 December 1935 the central army fell on the Italian camps while their garrisons were slack, took guns and supply dumps, and forced the Italians to suspend the offensive for several weeks. From February 1936 the Italians changed to the pocket technique: aircraft reconnaissance and artillery fire drove the Ethiopian formations into narrow valleys, and armour and infantry then closed both flanks at once; the Battle of Maychew on 31 March 1936 was won this way. The Ethiopian side fought from natural strongpoints of plateau fortress, terraced fields and rock walls, forcing the Italians to take position after position, and the front dissolved into a running series of isolated engagements.
data: 數字上可以確定的部分有限，但輪廓大致清楚：一九三五年十月三日越境當日，義大利自厄立特里亞方向投入的正規軍約二十萬人，格拉齊亞尼在索馬利蘭方向另率一支規模較小的部隊，全役義方投入兵力（含海運、勞動與後勤）常被估計在數十萬量級；埃塞俄比亞方面，中央軍與各省民兵合計常被概估為五十萬上下，但真正受過成建制訓練並配備現代武器的只是其中一部分。距離上，自邊境沿公路至亞的斯亞貝巴的行程逾一千公里，阿姆巴阿拉吉一線距首都約二百五十至三百公里，義軍必須在雨季之前吃下這段高原。裝備上，三十五式自走砲全役投入的數目在數十輛上下，義方常被引述的損失為陣亡一萬數千、負傷與失蹤合計數萬，埃方軍人損失的統計口徑分歧更大。空軍方面，皇家空軍在一九三五年底至一九三六年春的四個月內投下約三百三十公噸芥子氣，違反一九二五年日內瓦議定書。
dataEn: Only part of the record can be fixed with confidence, but the outline is clear enough. On the day the border was crossed, 3 October 1935, the Italians committed about 200,000 regular troops from Eritrea, with Graziani leading a smaller force from the Somaliland direction; total Italian commitment over the campaign, including shipping, labour and rear services, is usually estimated in the hundreds of thousands. On the Ethiopian side, the central army and the provincial levies together are often put at something like half a million, though only a fraction of them were trained regular units properly equipped with modern weapons. As for distance, the run from the border to Addis Ababa along the road exceeds a thousand kilometres, and the Amba Alagi line lies roughly two hundred and fifty to three hundred kilometres from the capital; the Italians had to take that stretch of highland before the rains. On equipment, the number of M35 tanks committed over the whole campaign was on the order of a few dozen, Italian losses are commonly given as some fifteen thousand dead with wounded and missing adding up to several tens of thousands, and estimates of Ethiopian military losses vary far more widely. On the air side, the Regia Aeronautica dropped roughly 330 tonnes of mustard gas over the four months from late 1935 into the spring of 1936, in breach of the 1925 Geneva Protocol.
cause: 打起來的直接導火線是一九三四年十一月二十三日的沃勒沃勒事件：義大利在奧加登修建的沃勒沃勒堡塞越過了一九二八年《義埃條約》劃定的二十一里格邊界線，英埃邊界委員會前往調查時與索馬里邊防部隊交火，義方人員陣亡，埃方多人被俘。深層原因則是法西斯義大利在非洲之角的殖民擴張：北非與索馬利蘭等地的征服，使墨索里尼把埃塞俄比亞視為最後一塊拼圖，公開的說法是義大利要為一八九六年阿杜瓦的敗仗雪恥，並把所謂文明使命推行到門戶之地。國際環境同樣關鍵：國聯在侵略成形之後才於十一月十八日實施制裁，卻把石油排除在制裁之外；美國一九三五年的中立法案也不把石油列入禁運，倫敦與巴黎在恐懼與利益之間動搖，沒有一個國家願意為一條二十一里格的線承擔開戰風險。於是墨索里尼的判斷是：以二十萬大軍開打，不會有人攔他。
causeEn: The immediate trigger was the Walwal incident of 23 November 1934: the fort the Italians had built at Walwal in the Ogaden lay beyond the twenty-one league boundary laid down by the 1928 Italo-Ethiopian treaty, and when the Anglo-Ethiopian boundary commission came to investigate it clashed with the Somali frontier garrison, Italian personnel were killed and several Ethiopians taken prisoner. The deeper cause was the fascist colonial expansion of Italy in the Horn of Africa. The conquests in North Africa and Somaliland left Ethiopia for Mussolini as the last piece of the puzzle, and the public line was that Italy was going to wipe out the defeat of Adwa in 1896 and carry a civilising mission to the gates of the continent. The international environment mattered just as much: the League of Nations imposed sanctions only on 18 November, after the aggression had already taken shape, and left oil out of them; United States neutrality legislation in 1935 likewise excluded oil from the embargo, and London and Paris wavered between fear and self-interest, with no state willing to fight over a line of twenty-one leagues. Mussolini's conclusion was that an army of two hundred thousand could march and no one would stop him.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接政治後果，是集體安全的體系被當場戳破。國聯的制裁既沒能阻止侵略，也沒能執行到底，德拉姆斯特拉集團就此瓦解，義大利在歐洲被孤立，轉而把重心移向德國，一九三六年十月羅馬與柏林的軸心成形，軸心集團的輪廓由此畫定。軍事上，義大利用一場大規模的機械化加空軍支援的戰役解決了高原障礙，卻也暴露了財政極限：戰爭把國家預算推向失衡，軍費佔比抬升，而得來的東非殖民地在經濟上遠不足以回本，反而加深了長線負擔。對埃塞俄比亞而言，這是一線部隊與舊式軍制的崩潰，卻也是一次徹底的軍制斷裂：戰後中央軍以新式營、機槍連與完整後勤重建，一九三六年之後投入西班牙內戰的國際縱隊，正是從這次失敗裡學到的東西，一九四一年英軍東非戰役打回亞的斯亞貝巴時，義大利在非洲之角的全部經營早已結束。作戰方法上，這場戰役示範的縱隊行軍、空中偵察配合地面火力，以及對固守陣地使用化學武器的做法，在此後的西班牙與歐洲戰場被反覆沿用，成為二戰初期一套可辨認的作戰指紋。
impactEn: The direct political consequence of the war was the puncturing of the collective security system on the spot. League sanctions neither stopped the aggression nor carried through, the Stresa Front fell apart, Italy was isolated in Europe and turned its weight towards Germany; the Rome-Berlin axis was formed in October 1936 and the shape of the Axis group was fixed. Militarily, Italy solved the problem of the highlands with a large-scale mechanised and air-supported campaign, but she also exposed her financial limit: the war drove the state budget out of balance, the military share of spending rose, and the East African colonies acquired were economically far from paying for themselves, adding to the long-term burden. For Ethiopia the collapse of the front-line units and the old system was total, but it was also a clean break in the army's structure: afterwards the central force was rebuilt on new-style battalions, machine-gun companies and a proper logistic system, and the International Brigades that went to the Spanish Civil War in 1936 learned their lessons from this defeat. When the British East African campaign retook Addis Ababa in 1941, the whole Italian position in the Horn had been finished long before. In operational terms, the column march, aerial reconnaissance fused with ground fire, and the use of chemical weapons against entrenched positions demonstrated here were repeated in Spain and later in Europe, becoming a recognisable operational fingerprint of the early second world war.
result: 結果是埃塞俄比亞中央軍的有組織抵抗被打散。一九三六年三月三十一日梅喬戰役中，埃塞俄比亞主力在拉斯·德斯塔指揮下遭圍殲，海萊·塞拉西一世於五月二日離開亞的斯亞貝巴出走流亡，五月三日《亞的斯亞貝巴條約》簽訂，義大利放棄對厄立特里亞與義屬索馬利蘭的國聯委任統治，換取國際社會對佔領事實的默認；五月五日巴多格里奧的部隊進入首都，五月九日墨索里尼宣布吞併，非洲義大利殖民地成立，埃托雷·巴斯蒂科出任總督。軍備與編制的結局同樣徹底：中央軍殘部與民兵退入游擊階段，埃塞俄比亞境內散落著大批義制與英制武器，一九三九年第二次世界大戰爆發時，這支重建過的軍隊將在東非戰線上與義大利再遇，而它重返亞的斯亞貝巴的時間是一九四一年五月。
resultEn: The result was the destruction of organised Ethiopian resistance. At the Battle of Maychew on 31 March 1936 the Ethiopian main army was encircled and destroyed under Ras Desta; Haile Selassie I left Addis Ababa and went into exile on 2 May; the Treaty of Addis Ababa was signed on 3 May, by which Italy renounced its League of Nations mandate over Eritrea and Italian Somaliland in exchange for the world's acquiescence in the occupation. On 5 May Badoglio's troops entered the capital, and on 9 May Mussolini proclaimed the annexation, the colony of Italian East Africa being created with Ettore Bastico as governor general. The military reckoning was just as complete: the remnants of the central army and the militia fell back into a guerrilla phase, and Ethiopia was left strewn with Italian and British weapons. When the second world war broke out in 1939 this rebuilt army was to meet Italy again on the East African front, and it returned to Addis Ababa in May 1941.
